scripts.preinstall:
node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['package-lock.json', 'yarn.lock'].forEach(f => fs.existsSync(f) && fs.unlinkSync(f)); if (!/pnpm/.test(process.env.npm_config_user_agent || '')) { console.error('
========================================================
[ERROR] Este proyecto usa pnpm workspaces (catalogos y rutas locales).
Por favor, ejecuta: pnpm install
========================================================
'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); const cwd=process.cwd(); const root=cwd.endsWith('os-history')?path.resolve(cwd,'../..'):cwd; const src=path.resolve(root,'artifacts/os-history/dist'); if(fs.existsSync(src)){ [path.resolve(root,'dist'),path.resolve(root,'dist/public')].forEach(target=>{ fs.mkdirSync(target,{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync(src,target,{recursive:true}); }); console.log('[postbuild] Synced build artifacts successfully.'); }"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
